g.text: ESP32-S3 DevKit (362 KB usable SRAM · 8.0 MB flash)
Speed: not measured on this board. Only esp32, nano33ble have real numbers; a
guess here would be wrong by up to 3x.
Method: tflm-wasm32-measurement (+28 KB runtime overhead, +0 B scratch margin)
Caveat: reads about 2,128 B high against a real ESP32, a fixed amount rather
than a percentage, which is 3% of this arena. Treat it as a ceiling.
• Leaves ~280 KB RAM for your application, sensor buffers, and network stack.
Arduino Uno R3 (2 KB usable SRAM · 32 KB flash)
- needs ~82 KB RAM, board has 2 KB usable; needs 444 KB flash,
Method: tflm-wasm32-measurement (+28 KB runtime overhead, +0 B scratch margin)
Caveat: reads about 2,128 B high against a real ESP32, a fixed amount rather
than a percentage, which is 3% of this arena. Treat it as a ceiling.
• Smallest boards that fit this model as-is: STM32F411 "BlackPill", BBC
